import MilneLib.Affine.StableAffineSections

/-!
# Extending affine quotient-section conditions

Injectivity and the invariant-section description of pullback on affine opens
extend to arbitrary opens by the sheaf axioms. This permits the geometric
quotient criterion to use only the affine-open conditions in Milne I.8.10.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

namespace MilneLib

/-- Pullback injectivity can be checked on affine opens of the target. -/
theorem app_injective_of_affineOpen {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y)
    (hinj : ∀ U : Y.Opens, IsAffineOpen U → Function.Injective (q.app U).hom)
    (U : Y.Opens) : Function.Injective (q.app U).hom := by
  intro s t hst
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.section_ext Y.sheaf.2
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hyV, hVU⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset hy
  refine ⟨V, hVU, hyV, hinj V hV ?_⟩
  have hn (a : Γ(Y, U)) :=
    congrArg (fun f => f.hom a) (q.naturality (homOfLE hVU).op)
  exact (hn s).trans ((congrArg
    (X.presheaf.map ((Opens.map q.base).map (homOfLE hVU)).op).hom hst).trans
      (hn t).symm)

namespace StableGroupAction

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (act : G →* Aut X) (q : X ⟶ Y) (hInv : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ q = q)

/-- The invariant-section description on affine opens determines the image of
pullback over every open. Unique affine lifts glue because pullback is injective. -/
theorem mem_range_app_iff_actApp_of_affineOpen
    (hinj : ∀ U : Y.Opens, IsAffineOpen U → Function.Injective (q.app U).hom)
    (hfixed : ∀ (U : Y.Opens), IsAffineOpen U →
      ∀ s : Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ U),
        s ∈ Set.range (q.app U).hom ↔
          ∀ g : G, (actApp act (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hInv U)
            g).hom s = s)
    (U : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) :
    s ∈ Set.range (q.app U).hom ↔
      ∀ g : G, (actApp act (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hInv U)
        g).hom s = s := by
  classical
  have hn (V W : Y.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V) (t : Γ(Y, V)) :
      (q.app W).hom ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op).hom t) =
        (X.presheaf.map ((Opens.map q.base).map (homOfLE hWV)).op).hom
          ((q.app V).hom t) :=
    congrArg (fun f => f.hom t) (q.naturality (homOfLE hWV).op)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩ g
    exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom t) (app_actApp_of_invariant act q hInv U g)
  · intro hs
    let I := {V : Y.affineOpens // V.1 ≤ U}
    let V : I → Y.Opens := fun i => i.1.1
    have hVU (i : I) : V i ≤ U := i.2
    have hcover : U ≤ ⨆ i, V i := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨W, hW, hyW, hWU⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset hy
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨⟨W, hW⟩, hWU⟩, hyW⟩
    have hl : ∀ i : I, ∃ t : Γ(Y, V i), (q.app (V i)).hom t =
        (X.presheaf.map ((Opens.map q.base).map (homOfLE (hVU i))).op).hom s := by
      intro i
      apply (hfixed (V i) i.1.2 _).mpr
      intro g
      have hh := actApp_map act
        (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hInv U)
        (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hInv (V i))
        ((Opens.map q.base).monotone (hVU i)) g
      exact (congrArg (fun f => f.hom s) hh).symm.trans
        (congrArg (X.presheaf.map
          ((Opens.map q.base).map (homOfLE (hVU i))).op).hom (hs g))
    choose t ht using hl
    have hcpt : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible Y.presheaf V t := by
      intro i j
      apply app_injective_of_affineOpen q hinj (V i ⊓ V j)
      change (q.app (V i ⊓ V j)).hom
          ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op).hom (t i)) =
        (q.app (V i ⊓ V j)).hom
          ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op).hom (t j))
      rw [hn, hn, ht, ht]
      simp only [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← X.presheaf.map_comp]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := Y.sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' V U
      (fun i => homOfLE (hVU i)) hcover t hcpt
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    apply TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.section_ext X.sheaf.2
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (hcover hx)
    refine ⟨q ⁻¹ᵁ V i, (Opens.map q.base).monotone (hVU i), hi, ?_⟩
    have hnat := hn U (V i) (hVU i) a
    exact hnat.symm.trans
      ((congrArg (q.app (V i)).hom (ha i)).trans (ht i))

end StableGroupAction

end MilneLib
